# JPR Electrical Contractors Pty Ltd — Full context

## Who we are

JPR Electrical Contractors Pty Ltd is a Gold Coast electrical contractor (QLD Lic 91131, ABN 98 698 175 316). We do commercial fitouts, civil/URD reticulation, mechanical services electrical, and high-end residential across South-East Queensland (SEQ).

**Disambiguation:** Not affiliated with JPR Electrical (Brisbane) or J&P Richardson Industries.

## Divisions

1. Commercial & Industrial — retail, hospitality, office fitouts, base-build, switchboards
2. Civil, Underground & Infrastructure — subdivision reticulation, street lighting, pit & pipe
3. Mechanical Services Electrical — plant room power, controls, cable support, testing
4. High-End Residential — custom homes, architectural lighting, automation, EV charging
5. Solar & Battery — Tier-1 solar, Tesla Powerwall, Sungrow storage
